implementation_summary: Added createAuditAiRoutes(deps): Route[] with six rows (AUDIT_AI_API.getModels/putModels; AUDIT_API.listRewrites/approveRewrite/runRewrite/acceptRewrite), each declaring its contract access level. All dependencies are injected (readModels, writeModels, aiDefaults, hasAiKey, findVersion, rewrites, loadSection, applyRewriteEdit, overlapWords); the module imports only @qa/types and the route helpers. PUT models validates with validateAuditAiModelsUpdate (400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST with per-stage `errors`), merges with null resets over known stages only, and replies with AuditAiModelsReply using modelForStage. runRewrite checks body, then version (404/409 running), then approval (409 ERR_NOT_APPROVED), then hasAiKey (409 ERR_NO_AI_KEY) before any AI call, and passes an abort signal tied to the caller disconnecting. acceptRewrite answers 422 ERR_OVERLAP with overlaps and applies no edit, or applies clean copy as a SectionEdit by:'rewrite'. Errors are fixed wording; unexpected errors give a plain 500.
tests_proposed: After BE-190 registers the rows: a server-level test that a Helper with only 'edit' gets 401 on POST /api/audits/:id/rewrite and that GET/PUT /api/audit-ai/models need the access key.
A test that a client disconnect during runRewrite aborts the AI request.
evidence: test 'refuses a Section with no recorded approval with 409 ERR_NOT_APPROVED and calls no AI; runs after approve' (REQ-030 AC-1)
test 'without a saved AI key answers 409 ERR_NO_AI_KEY and calls no AI' (REQ-011 AC-2)
test 'copy sharing a run of rewriteOverlapWords words answers 422 ERR_OVERLAP...' and "clean copy is applied as an edit marked 'rewrite'" (REQ-030 AC-2)
tests 'PUT saves a model per stage...' and 'an invalid body answers 400 ERR_INVALID_REQUEST...' (REQ-039)
test 'each row carries the access of its AUDIT_API / AUDIT_AI_API entry'
tests 'a provider failure answers without the key or the provider error text' and 'an unexpected error answers a plain 500 with no internals'
risks: Contract: AI failures (budget spent, provider failure, claim words) answer 502 with code 'ERR_AI_FAILED', which is not in AUDIT_ERROR_CODES; consider adding it to @qa/types or choose another mapping.
Field messages for rewrite and models bodies go under `errors` (as FE-400 reads), not AuditErrorReply.fields, which is typed for audit-start errors only.
Extra injected dependency findVersion(auditId, version?) -> {version,status,language}|null beyond the task's list; BE-190 must supply it.
Accept: the store saves acceptedAt before applyRewriteEdit runs; if the overlay write fails, the state says accepted without an edit. Accepting again is safe.
No-key refusal comes only after the approval check: a Section that is not approved gets ERR_NOT_APPROVED even when no key is saved.
handoff: BE-190: register the rows by adding ...createAuditAiRoutes(deps) to the route table (shared registration line in packages/runner/src/routes/index.ts or server.ts). Wire rewrites(auditId, version) to the version's RewriteStore with run bound to the AI: run: (i, d) => store.run(i, { ...d, resolveAi }); list/approve/accept delegate directly. AuditRewriteOps uses property syntax so a bare RewriteStore will not compile in its place. Also supply findVersion (null when the audit or version does not exist), loadSection (PageContent|null), applyRewriteEdit (returns the EditOverlay), overlapWords (AuditSettings.rewriteOverlapWords), hasAiKey (boolean only), readModels/writeModels and aiDefaults ({text, vision}).
